metadata.tornado_track_policy: Tornado tracks must come from DAT. NCEI begin/end coordinates are not used as a tornado track substitute.

properties.event_narrative: The Bird Springs chapter house reported flooding overtopped the N-71 bridge near N-2. Road and bridge are still flooded as of around 11 AM the following (Thursday) morning_ along with an estimated 38 houses/properties impacted in the Transwestern Rd area about 5 miles west of Bird Springs.

Approximate start point of a brief EF1 rated tornado. Peak winds estimated to be 110 mph with path width of about 600 yards. The tornado proceeded about 2.3 miles northeast before dissipating just west of Highway 180.
A former NWS employee reported dozens of 1-2 ft diameter ponderosa pine trees down in the forest. Some trees were snapped. Time is estimated based on radar signatures.

An EF1 rated tornado developed south of Walker and traveled north-northeast across Walker Road. The estimated maximum wind speed was 105 mph along its 8 mile path. Maximum width was estimated to be 300 yards.

A USGS stream gauge on the Moenkopi Wash reported an 8 ft rise in 15 minutes at 10:30 AM. Water levels continued to rise all afternoon reaching a 13 ft rise by 4:53 pm with a flow of about 13_400 cfs. KAFF News also shared photos on Facebook of flooding in the Hopi village of Moenkopi.

*** 1 INJ *** Approximate start point of an EF-1 rated tornado that moved north through the Heber-Overgaard area. Peak winds estimated to be 110 mph along its 11 minute journey. The path was just over 9 miles with maximum width estimated to be around 350 yards. There was 1 non life-threatening injury reported.

*** 1 INJ *** 46 structures sustained damaged in Heber-Overgaard. There was 1 non life-threatening injury to a bicyclist. Time of report is estimated by radar. Further information will be provided after damage assessments are completed.
